scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn epoint_sandbox.main:app --reload --port 8181
scripts.build: bun run tokens && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.test: bun run test:web && bun run test:api
scripts.lint: bun run lint:web && bun run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src
scripts.format: biome format --write . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: biome format . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run lint:api
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run test
